title.zh: 【Absa 成为非洲大陆首家提供数字资产托管服务的银行】
title.en: 【Absa 成为非洲大陆首家提供数字资产托管服务的银行】

current_state.zh: South Africa's Absa received regulatory approval to become the first bank in Africa to offer digital asset custody, initially supporting Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP and USDC for institutional clients.
